Impacted Assessment Segments

Highlighted river segments indicate those impacted in part or whole by this fish kill event. It is not meant to represent the actual extent of the kill.

Onsite Comments

Location: The fish kill originated from an outflow at AgriStar Meat & Poultry, LLC. Dead fish were observed along 7,949 yards of Hecker Creek beginning at its source at the plant (43.0945, -91.5790) and ending at its mouth (43.1381, -91.5676).

Cause of Kill: Discharge of contaminated firefighting runoff carrying high levels of ammonia from the AgriStar facility through an outflow into Hecker Creek.
